title: Regularity theory for sub-critical $p$-parabolic systems with measurable coefficients
summary: A quantitative regularity theory is developed for weak solutions to the parabolic system $$ \partial_t u-\mathrm{div}\,{\boldsymbol{\mathsf A}}(x,t,Du)=0 \quad\text{in }E_T\subset \mathbb{R}^N\times\mathbb{R}, $$ which features the $p$-Laplacian with measurable coefficients. We focus on the sub-critical range $1 \frac{N(2-p)}{p}$, we derive sharp, scale-invariant $L^\infty$-estimates. \emph{Higher integrability of the gradient:} $|Du|$ self-improves from $L^p_{\mathrm{loc}}$ to $L^{p(1+\varepsilon)}_{\mathrm{loc}}$ for some $\varepsilon>0$ depending only on the data.
